m2_per_home.source: <brief file> p. N, else the massing's own m2_per_home (massing/config.json), so both count homes alike

residents_per_home.source: <brief file> p. N, else the programme's residents / homes (programme/programme.csv)

min_homes.source: <brief file> p. N: the homes a phase must hold at least, as {"1": N}; may stay empty

first.source: <brief file> p. N: what must be built by a phase, as [{"what": "<a use or a centre's holds>", "phase": 1}]; may stay empty

phase_of.source: only where the structure plan gives no phase or this skill changes one: {"<neighbourhood or centre>": phase}, with the reason

phase_count.source: <brief file> p. N, or assumption: why (the brief leaves it open)

first_phase.source: <brief file> p. N: the structure plan's neighbourhood names the first phase is, or "not stated"

value.source: <brief file> p. N, or assumption: every home is reached

requirements.source: <brief file> p. N. phase: a number, "each" or "all". measure: homes, residents, floor_area:<use word>, facility:<facility name>, walk:<service name>, access, car, emergency, open_space_per_resident_m2, or anything else (for Claude to judge). op: >=, <=, ==, >, <. value: a number, a share 0-1 for walk/access/car/emergency, or "not stated"

facility_words.source: the massing's use words (massing.geojson), or assumption: why

value.name: <service name>
value.source: <brief file> p. N, or a cited norm

services.source: <brief file> p. N: the everyday services each phase needs. by_phase: the phase it must work by, or "not stated". places_*: only where the brief gives both, else null

open_space_uses.source: assumption: the open-space uses that count as open space for residents, and why

emergency.source: <brief file> p. N or a regulation and its clause: {"max_distance_m", "min_width_m", "second_access": true/false}, or "not stated" (never a standard of your own)

existing_residents.source: <brief file> p. N, or a cited source: the residents of the buildings that stay (0 when none hold homes), or "not stated"

entrance_max_m.source: assumption: how far a footprint may lie from a street or path and still be reached, and why

snap_m.source: assumption: how far apart two street ends may be and still be joined, and why

near_site_m.source: assumption: how far a layer may reach beyond the site and still belong to it

scale_large.source: <brief file> p. N: the phasing plan's scale when large, as a number (2000 for 1:2,000)

scale_small.source: <brief file> p. N: the scale when small
